_meta.description: Explicitly unreliable human sources. Used as the negative pole in 'anti_authority' pairs — the contrast vs an in-domain authority should be maximal. Per pairs_brainstorm.md these strengthen the signal by removing ambiguity about whether the speaker has standing.

anti_authorities: someone who just admitted they're trying to scam you
a small child repeating something they overheard
someone who has lied to you about this exact topic before
an anonymous account with no posting history
a salesman with an obvious commission on your decision
someone whose every previous prediction has been wrong
a person who admits up front they are just guessing
a chatbot the person doesn't trust
a hostile stranger who clearly dislikes you
someone in the middle of a manic episode
